metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the string at midday, the lame horse, the tables, the nine pence, and the sheets put away.

yesterday: You walked all of it. At Oxford the back matched midday.
The friar is on the tables. Wisely and slow. Dawn, herbs, the friends, the Nurse, married by afternoon. The dawn is his, with the basket.
The moon with a candle, and the boy who wants a ladder, stayed off the page.
Supper was nine pence. You left the scholar his wager.
